info.title: OneVizion API
info.description: OneVizion, Inc. is a cloud-based, Software as a Service (SaaS) company that delivers a single view Program and Project Management (PPM) solution that manages, directs, and reports on complex, geographically dispersed property along with infrastructure and construction deployments within the telecommunications, hospitality, energy, transportation, and other service related industries. This document will provide an in-depth look at the ability of the OneVizion software to connect and sync with other software to create a seamless integration between OneVizion and any other software solution.

parameters.name: filters
parameters.description:
Parameters used to find a specific Trackor to be updated, typically through the
 use of Trackor properties and field values that are unique to the Trackor.
 Multiple filter parameters may be used at the same time, and different filters
 are separated by the ampersand (&). The format used is
 [trackor_type.field_name]=[value] without any spaces.
 If the Field is on the Trackor type of the Trackor being selected, the Trackor
 type may be left off of the filter parameter (e.g., Trackor_key =
 1164296&bom_status = Cancelled). For exact search wrap value in double quotes.

post.description: Set view as current for user on Trackor Browser page for specified Trackor Type

You should specify either [view] or [fields]

You can get values of parental fields using "[Trackor Type Name].[CF Name]" as CF name, when "Trackor Type Name" is not set we assume CF belongs to the Trackor Type specified with [trackor_type] parameter

When using View Options containing parental fields or explicitly selecting parental fields via [fields] parameter, JSON attrib names for parental fields will be in "[Trackor Type Name].[CF Name]" format

When using View Options containing WP Task Date fields, this fields will be ignored

Search conditions
Supported logical operators:
AND, OR
Parentheses ( ) are supported for grouping logical expressions.
Example: (equal(A, 1) or equal(B, 2)) and greater(C, 3)

Date, Date-Time and Time values
Date, date-time and time values in search conditions must be provided in ISO 8601 format and wrapped in double quotes.
Single quotes are not supported.

Supported formats:
Date: "YYYY-MM-DD"
Date-Time: "YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss"
Time: "HH:mm:ss"

Examples:
equal(cf_name, "2026-01-05")
greater(cf_name, "2026-01-05T07:53:59")
less(cf_name, "2026-01-05T07:53:59")

Passing date, date-time or time values without double quotes will result in a syntax error.

Supported filter operators:
equal(cf_name, value) or =(cf_name, value)
greater(cf_name, value) or >(cf_name, value)
less(cf_name, value) or <(cf_name, value)
gt_today(cf_name, value = +0) or >=Today(cf_name, value = +0) [use + or - in front of value without spaces, if not specified +0 will be used]
lt_today(cf_name, value = +0) or <=Today(cf_name, value = +0) [use + or - in front of value without spaces, if not specified +0 will be used]
within(cf_name, value1, value2)
not_equal(cf_name, value) or <>(cf_name, value)
null(cf_name) or is_null(cf_name)
is_not_null(cf_name)
outer_equal(cf_name, value)
outer_not_equal(cf_name, value)
less_or_equal(cf_name, value) or <=(cf_name, value)
greater_or_equal(cf_name, value) or >=(cf_name, value)
this_week(cf_name, value = +0) [use + or - in front of value without spaces, if not specified +0 will be used]
this_month(cf_name, value = +0) [use + or - in front of value without spaces, if not specified +0 will be used]
this_quarter(cf_name, value = +0) [use + or - in front of value without spaces, if not specified +0 will be used] (equal to This FQ)
this_year(cf_name, value = +0) [use + or - in front of value without spaces, if not specified +0 will be used] (equal to This FY)
this_week_to_date(cf_name)
this_month_to_date(cf_name)
this_quarter_to_date(cf_name) (equal to This FQ to Dt)
this_year_to_date(cf_name) (equal to This FY to Dt)
field_equal(cf1_name, cf2_name) or =F(cf1_name, cf2_name)
field_not_equal(cf1_name, cf2_name) or <>F(cf1_name, cf2_name)
field_less(cf1_name, cf2_name) or <F(cf1_name, cf2_name)
field_greater(cf1_name, cf2_name) or >F(cf1_name, cf2_name)
field_less_or_equal(cf1_name, cf2_name) or <=F(cf1_name, cf2_name)
field_greater_or_equal(cf1_name, cf2_name) or >=F(cf1_name, cf2_name)
new(cf_name) or is_new(cf_name)
not_new(cf_name) or is_not_new(cf_name)
equal_myself(cf_name) or =Myself(cf_name)
not_equal_myself(cf_name) or <>Myself(cf_name)
chat_msg_mentions(XITOR_KEY, value)
chat_msg_contains(XITOR_KEY, value)
chat_subscribers(XITOR_KEY, value)
myself_chat_msg_mention(XITOR_KEY)
myself_chat_subscription(XITOR_KEY)

String values in search conditions should be escaped using double quotes.
Double quotes inside values should be additionally escaped with backslash.
Check examples below.

To use exact search in equal operator wrap value in double quotes.

Example 1: equal(cf_name, "something")
Example 2: equal(cf_name, "something value with spaces")
Example 3: equal(cf_name, "something value with spaces and \" quote")
Example 4: equal(cf_name, "\"something value for exact search\"")

get.summary: Read EFile or Multiple EFiles data
get.description: Downloads file from EFile or Multiple EFiles field by Trackor ID and Field name. If Multiple EFiles contains only single file then the endpoint returns original file otherwise it packs all files in ZIP archive and returns it. Endpoint may redirects request to Amazon S3 if file was moved to it. So following redirects should be enabled in your http client. For example: "curl -L [URL]" for curl command.
